title: Find Common Characters
statement:
Given a string array words, return an array of all characters that show up in all strings within the words (including duplicates). Return the answer in lexicographically ascending order, including duplicate characters.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: words = ["bella","label","roller"]
Output: ["e","l","l"]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: words = ["cool","lock","cook"]
Output: ["c","o"]
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= words.length <= 100
- 1 <= words[i].length <= 100
- words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
